goal: FG-322: change --run runs the selected checks

components.summary: Dispatches current-tree commands and reports progress toward one target.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch to map, proof and template commands; keep scan project ignores untouched and print one empty-model release summary; contract template setup names COMPONENTS and PARENT; export read --mermaid, optionally focused by component; map models and release fail a model with an uncovered invariant, counted once; show each scoped cycle or layer violation once as an ARCH line in change; include the built-in system root in release declared/executed counts; models --tests runs bound tests and release always checks their individual implementation reach; non-strict check and change annotate only planned breakage, report static target work without running target models, and release warns about a target while checking only the strict current tree; keep the ui-flow capability template entrypoint as the same native ui-journey factory while retiring the old ui-flow-structure template name; keep the contract-exhaustion capability template command as the same validator factory; after normal release checks and bound tests pass, optionally invoke the exact whole-suite shard tool once, keeping normal TESTED_BY execution separate from within-suite exactness; template writes model files into the active target when present, preserving other output paths and force semantics and naming target check as the next step

show the existing owner of a behavior and the component that defines an exact symbol, with files, state and side effects (read --find) and owning model ids, or name the closest owners when none matches; read --target shows static node changes and supports component details or Mermaid, while --find remains a separate mode; read --budget N passes the same character budget as map show --budget; read --review and map show --review print the same ranked architecture review
direct retired workflow flags and legacy project detection to references/upgrade.md while preserving their rejection status
run the selected tests and models on request
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm
